children: Our Bureau New Delhi: Tata Electronics on Thursday announced seven partnerships and collaborations with global semiconductor companies and Indian institutions as it moves to build the supply chain around its planned chip fab in Gujarat and packaging facility in Assam.

The announcements are part of 16 semiconductor industry partnerships being made over the two-day Semicon India 2026. The partners include Nexperia, Fujifilm, JSR Corporation and BE Semiconductor Industries, along with Semiconductor Laboratory, Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya and Ascendas Firstspace.

title: Tata Electronics Ties up with Seven Firms for Gujarat Chip Fab
